about.en: English for adult readers (P27a, C4.4), taught through Dari and Pashto. A first three lessons as drafts; the content team adds the rest (about ten). Every English word is recorded by a human English speaker and every instruction by native Dari and Pashto speakers before release; no Dari-script spelling of English words, because the recording is the model. The Dari and Pashto lines are drafts for native speakers.
